title: Review of the CIPS turnover-window finding on fresh seed 5: doubled turnover gives a shrinking dot that never divides (184 -> 94 px) while g1 goes 5 -> 12; halved turnover gives a filament that grows to 1135 px and stalls g1 (5 -> 9), but here it does break once (t~8100, into 869 + 255 px)
summary: Ran the finding's world.py and sel.py with inoc_mix 1 and b2 +1 or -0.5 on fresh seed 5 to t=10000, and a labkit pack of the b2 -0.5 arm (seed 5, 100 frames of 100 t). b2 +1: one g2 body, 184 px at t=1600 shrinking to 94 px at t=10000, never divides; g1 bodies 5 -> 12. b2 -0.5: one g2 body grows to a filament of 1135 px by t=8000 and breaks at t~8100 into 869 and 255 px, both g2, which keep growing (991 and 372 px at t=10000); g1 bodies 5 -> 9. labkit (b2 -0.5): 3 persistent splits, generation 1, 9 persistent tracks.

observations.D: sheet_s5.png row 1 and assayb_s5_b1.0.json: the high-turnover g2 body shrinks 184 -> 125 -> 110 -> 108 -> 100 -> 94 px (t=1600-10000) and never divides, while g1 bodies go 5 -> 12. Row 2 and assayb_s5_b-0.5.json: the low-turnover g2 body grows 254 -> 343 -> 670 -> 887 -> 1135 px (t=1600-8000) as a box-spanning filament, while g1 bodies go only 5 -> 8 -> 9; at t=8100 the filament breaks into 869 + 255 px (both pure g2), so on this seed it does divide once, after reaching ~10x the normal body area.

seeds_run.result: pass for b2 +1 (no division, shrinking dot) and for the stalled g1 under b2 -0.5; partial for 'never pinches': the b2 -0.5 filament breaks once at t~8100 at 1135 px

controls_run.D: the g1 bodies in the same boxes (default turnover): 5 -> 12 (beside the b2 +1 dot) and 5 -> 9 (beside the b2 -0.5 filament)

verdicts.limitation: One seed and one body of each trait kind per box (coin assignment gave a single g2 body), so 'never divides' rests on one individual per arm. The filament's single break at 1135 px suggests a much longer cycle rather than no division at low turnover; a longer run would tell. I did not run the b2=0 reference on this seed (the author's twins from 20261026T2316 serve).
